topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: As I sorted through the items at the yard sale, my hands paused over a familiar, soft shape. It was him, my old teddy bear, the one who accompanied me through countless adventures and whispers. His fur, once pristine white, now bore the gentle patina of time, and his button eyes had a certain wisdom that only years of being hugged tightly by a child could impart. I must have been no more than five when I thought I had lost him forever. Here he was, waiting for me. It felt like a return, a long-overdue reunion. I carefully picked him up, and as I did, a wave of memories washed over me. This was more than a find; it was a piece of my past reaching out to me. I knew just where he would sit in my living room, a courteous guardian of my new and old stories alike.
